What is your opinion of Apple Music so far? Personally I love it, Beats 1 has been great, and although everyone is complaining about the UI I've found it works very well.

What is your opinion?
How are you liking Apple Music?
I'm digging it so far. I haven't listened to this much music since my teen years. The UI is fine for me, someone who has nothing to compare it to. Either way I'm sure they'll improve it over time.

This is my third streaming service so far, after Rdio, Spotify and Google, and I think after you learn how it works and after you understand the mentality behind the app it offers one of the best experiences out there.
Beats 1 in particular has been a huge surprise. I'm not a fan of most types of mainstream music, but they do a really good job of mixing the genres. Only thing I've yet to hear is country music.

I like its non-American catalog (as a huge fan of stuff like K-pop and C-pop). It's more extensive than Spotify when it comes to making my own playlists for k/c-pop. Although, I've also discovered more music of American (and other) artists than I have before thanks to the "for you" feature and playlists.

I really like it. The only things I would change are the way album art is displayed on iPhone -- because I really love album art but not when there's UI on it -- I'd make it only one click to add a song to My Music.

I love it! I just converted from Android (Been there since HTC Hero) to a used iPhone 5s this week and got to experience the first day of Music. I enjoy it. I love the playlist recommendations it gives me and it seems to really understand my taste and mix of music. Only thing for me is I have not been able to get ANY of the stations to work. I've tried Beats 1 dozens of times and all it says is "Can't connect at this time." I have cellular data enabled so IDK what else it could be. I'm sure I'll figure it out sooner or later but until then I'm enjoying it as is.

hate it: killed HomeSharing, requires to sign up with AppleID to listen to radio if not subsciber (did/will not subscribe as I do not have 24/7 wifi access and data plan are way too expensive and not unlimited in my city), messed up my iTunes library (many movies got changed to Home Movies, music intact since my library is on local drive) and not compatible with our family's iPod Nanos and Classics.

pretty god, with a few downsides. I wish I could dislike stuff (so maybe they stop suggesting pop to me) and some minor bugs. But most of the "for you" things are really nice, and my macbooks hard drive is happy too
